steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Media ownership determines who controls the production and distribution of media content, shaping what audiences see, hear, and read.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Conglomerates: massive corporations that own multiple media companies across different sectors — e.g. Disney (films, TV, streaming, theme parks, merchandise), Comcast (NBC, Sky, Universal).

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Vertical integration: a company controls different stages of production and distribution — e.g. Disney makes films (Marvel), distributes them (cinema release), and streams them (Disney+).

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Horizontal integration: a company acquires competitors at the same production stage — e.g. Disney buying 20th Century Fox, giving it more film content and market share.
